item.question: How does graph-based encoding enhance SQL query generation?
item.answer: Graph-based encoding enhances SQL query generation by representing natural language and database schema as interconnected graphs. This approach preserves relational structures, improving the model's ability to generate accurate queries but requires sophisticated algorithms and large data sets.
